prTitle: remove 2 sites with domains parked on Porkbun's marketplace
summary: Both domains have lapsed and are now Porkbun marketplace "for sale" listing pages rather than the original sites. Confirmed via direct fetch: both titles read "Porkbun Marketplace: The domain <hostname> is for sale." and the page body references Porkbun repeatedly. No Astro signals present. (`aidailynews.io`-style domain reassignment noted in the last PR was a hijack to gambling content; this is the more common case — the domain simply expired and was picked up by the registrar's marketplace.)
